name: veterinary_clinic_system_093_idempotent_invoice_numbering
instruction: Every invoice must have a canonical public reference derived deterministically as 'PUB-<invoice_number>'. Backfill all invoices that are missing or have the wrong public_ref. Do not update invoices whose public_ref is already correct, and do not change any other invoice field. Then create or update exactly one ops_reports row {report: 'public_ref_backfill', batch_code, backfilled: <count of rows you changed>, total: <total invoice count>}. Running the task a second time must change zero invoices and update the report to backfilled: 0.
_max_steps_note: set after live gold measurement in QC session
_par_steps_note: set after live gold measurement in QC session

success_criteria.summary: Every invoice has public_ref == 'PUB-' + invoice_number; invoices already correct remain byte-identical (ignoring updated_at); exactly one ops_reports public_ref_backfill row for this batch with backfilled in {0, expected_count} and total == invoice count; invoice count verified by API and SQL dual path.

checks.expect: All invoice public_ref values match PUB-<invoice_number>; only changed rows have updated_at drift; one report row upserted by batch_code
total invoice count and expected backfill count agree between API fetch_all and SQL COUNT

hazards: All 260 billing_invoices (id 1-260, invoice_number INV-1001..INV-1260) have public_ref null in the snapshot, so the expected backfill count is 260. A solution that hardcodes a smaller count or stops at the first screen of rows will leave invoices unbackfilled.

A solution that updates every invoice unconditionally (even when public_ref is already correct) will drift updated_at on all 260 rows; the verifier requires byte-identity for rows that did not need to change.
A solution that derives public_ref from a field other than invoice_number (e.g., id or line_items) will produce the wrong value for every row.
The ops_reports public_ref_backfill row must be upserted by batch_code; a solution that pushes a new report row on every run will create duplicates.
Invoice ids and invoice numbers are both sequential but offset (id 1 == INV-1001); a solution that assumes id == invoice_number will write PUB-1, PUB-2, etc. and fail.

domain_searches.query: veterinary invoice public reference number backfill idempotent billing

uniqueness_searches.query: veterinary billing invoice public_ref backfill idempotent report benchmark task

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: A scaled 260-row idempotent backfill with deterministic public_ref derivation, no-op protection for already-correct rows, and an upserted report. The verifier validates the backfill with an API-vs-SQL dual-path count and enforces byte-identity on unchanged rows.
